purpose: future matched test of broad cached FineWeb source sentences alone versus the same sentences coupled to faithful Qwen simplifications; no GPU job launched

intended_generation_not_launched.model: qwen3.5-9b or the current local Qwen model allowed by official accounting
intended_generation_not_launched.reason_not_launched: both H100s are occupied by the active semantic-view treatment/control pair; next allocation should wait for paired trajectory and frontier_consolidation evidence

future_source_by_rewrite_contrast.treatment: for each accepted source sentence, concatenate original sentence + accepted simplification
future_source_by_rewrite_contrast.control: use the identical source-sentence set and exact row-length sequence, filling extra words by same-source repetition rather than adding different facts
future_source_by_rewrite_contrast.shared_filler: remaining words drawn from the same official pool rows in identical order after the source/rewrite prefix
future_source_by_rewrite_contrast.screening: reject outputs with added numbers, missing source numbers, low entity retention, more than two new named-entity tokens, newline/disclaimer/artifact strings, fragment endings, extreme length ratios, or near-copy outputs
future_source_by_rewrite_contrast.required_before_training: materialized arms must pass exact word count, exact row-length matching, identical filler, source-string reconstruction, and seq256 visibility checks
